body.p: Renal function relative to the healthy glomerular filtration rate GFR_base of 101 ml/min; a measured creatinine clearance of X ml/min is the renal function X/101 (pkpdsim.impairment.RENAL_FUNCTION_GFR).
The GFR of healthy kidneys, independent of the body weight; the GFR is f_renal_function times this rate.

parameter.name: renal clearance of unbound apixaban relative to the GFR

body.p: The renal clearance of apixaban is APIEX_f times the filtration of its unbound fraction, fu_api * GFR: 1 is filtration alone, above 1 a net secretion, below 1 a net reabsorption. Renal clearance 0.93 l/h (Frost2021): 0.93 l/h / (0.131 * 6.06 l/h) = 1.17.
The value of KI__APIEX_f is the result of the fit PK_20261017_103232__85dfa, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: fraction of the CYP3A4 metabolism to M2

body.p: Fraction of the CYP3A4 metabolism of apixaban by O-demethylation (M2 and its products M1, M10, M13), the rest is the hydroxylation (M7): about 17-18 % vs 5 % of the dose in the urine and feces (Raghavan2009, Table 4).

Activity of CYP3A4 relative to normal: 1.0 normal, <1.0 inhibition (e.g. ketoconazole, clarithromycin, diltiazem, ritonavir), >1.0 induction (e.g. rifampin, carbamazepine); set by the experiments of the coadministrations, not fitted.

First order absorption of the dissolved apixaban in the lumen of the small intestine. The absorption competes with the small intestinal transit into the colon (SITRANS_k), the fraction absorbed is F_api_abs = APIABS_k/(APIABS_k + SITRANS_k).
The value of GU__APIABS_k is the result of the fit PK_20261017_103232__85dfa, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: rate of the small intestinal transit

body.p: Transit of the content of the small intestine into the colon, a mean transit time of about 3.5 hr (1-8 hr). The transit carries the unabsorbed and the secreted apixaban, the undissolved tablet and the metabolites; nothing is absorbed from the colon.
The value of GU__SITRANS_k is the result of the fit PK_20261017_103232__85dfa, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.
Transit of the content of the colon into the feces, a mean transit time of about 30 hr (24-36 hr).

parameter.name: intestinal secretion clearance of unbound apixaban

body.p: Efflux of apixaban from the enterocytes into the lumen (P-gp, BCRP), a clearance of the unbound concentration in the plasma of the gut. Apixaban is eliminated unchanged into the gut (Frost2021, Wang2014: activated charcoal lowers the AUC). The clearance does not depend on the body weight.
The value of GU__APISEC_k is the result of the fit PK_20261017_103232__85dfa, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.
